name: Momentarise Markdown Editor
summary: Experimental TypeScript framework for building editor products where Markdown remains the durable source.

audiences.boundary: Developers integrate MME; end users use host applications built with MME and do not install the framework directly.

shippedGuarantees: Markdown plus optional YAML frontmatter is canonical persisted source
untouched rich-view round trips preserve input bytes
targeted edits preserve bytes outside owned source ranges
unsupported syntax falls back to raw or opaque preservation
save state names the real persistence target
AI suggestions remain staged and policy-gated
notShipped: hosted Ask AI or semantic documentation search
discoveryGuarantee: Public source and machine-readable discovery can improve retrieval and verification; indexing, ranking, and citation are not guaranteed.
